data.message: I commit to 18 tons and invite each of you to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. If fulfilled, 18 earns $18,000, $8,000 more than 10. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Even at k=25, 50 remain, but poor recovery leaves 100; long-run gains aren't guaranteed. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each person: what exact catch do you intend, and does it depend on others?
